title: A map of major attention mechanisms
text:
This is a curated map, not a complete catalogue. There are hundreds of attention papers; I kept the ones that define a branch or that shipped in a notable model.
Dates are the approximate month of the first arXiv version. Edges are my judgement of “builds on or is closely related to”, not strict citations.

The zoo around attention keeps growing: sparse patterns, kernel tricks, SSMs, delta rules, hybrids. This page is a map of that zoo. Rows are families, the x-axis is time (first arXiv version, roughly), arrows mean builds on / closely related to.

title: A map of major attention mechanisms
text:
Cheat-sheet









Family
Cost in sequence length n
What the model carries at inference
Representative nodes




Full softmax
O(n²) compute
KV cache grows linearly with n
MHA, MQA/GQA, MLA, FlashAttention


Sparse / local softmax
O(n·w) to sub-quadratic
KV cache (windowed or top-k selected)
Sliding window, BigBird, NSA, DeepSeek Sparse


Linear / kernel
O(n)
one d×d matrix per head
Linear Transformer, Performer, Based


Gated recurrent / SSM
O(n)
fixed-size state, decayed over time
RetNet, GLA, Mamba-2, Lightning


Delta rule / TTT
O(n)
fixed-size state, error-corrected writes
DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Titans


Hybrids
mostly O(n), a few O(n²) layers
small state plus a small KV cache
Qwen3-Next, Kimi Linear, MiniMax-M1

title: About
text:
ML engineer at Wildberries. Graduated from Yandex School of Data Analysis and DGAP.
